caption: The plan screen lists eight offer types for Basic plus vendor claims (200,000+ stores, 20 to 40% bigger orders) that we did not test. The store name is hidden.
Basic is $4.99 every 30 days after a 7 day trial to 24 Nov; on our development store it was a test charge, approved without a payment method. The store name is hidden.
The Snowboard upgrade offer took about 8 minutes to set up; Product Page was the only location, and we saw the pop-up only in this in-app preview. The store name is hidden.
The offer saved as Active, but the banner said App Embed Status: Inactive, so it never showed on the storefront (0 views). The store name is hidden.
Uninstalling asks for a reason and sends the developer a request to delete customer data within 48 hours. Organization and store names are hidden.
